song.title: Ain't No Rest For The Wicked

guitar.notes: No single iconic signature guitar widely documented for this band.

tone.target: driving garage rock crunch with bright bite
tone.profile: driving garage rock crunch with bright bite
tone.summary: A tight, crunchy signal chain using a British amp model (UK 45) combined with an OD pedal for bite, emphasizing upper mids and controlled room ambience.
